attackers_goals: Remove evidence for mailbox export commands.
description: An attacker may use PowerShell to remove evidence of an export request for a mailbox as part of the clean-up stage.
investigative_actions: Examine the PowerShell command to identify which mailbox has been compromised. Investigate the host that executes the command for potential further exploitation.
name: PowerShell used to remove mailbox export request logs
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
